Post-episode Reflexion (not sent to GM):
New plan: I failed because I repeatedly tried to "take" items (water, banana, peach, eye of newt) that were not present in the current room, and I ignored the specific locations mentioned in the description (e.g., the passage to the reading room). I also wasted turns dropping and re-taking the book and pillow without checking if they contained the needed items. The correct strategy is to first explore the environment by moving to the reading room via the passage, as the ingredients are likely located there. Once there, I will identify the specific containers (cauldron, borpulus, zulpowand) and the ingredients, then follow the recipe steps in order: take the cauldron, pour water, mix with borpulus, add eye of newt, swirl with zulpowand, add banana, and finally add peach. Only after completing all steps will I attempt to brew the potion or declare the goal achieved.
